host_preparation_script:
set -eu
immutable=/root/aidoku-phase3/candidate12/source-snapshot
companion=/root/aidoku-phase3/candidate12/lease-verifier
components=/root/aidoku-phase3/candidate11/lease-verifier/scripts

test ! -L "$companion"
test ! -e /root/aidoku-phase3/evidence/candidate12/live-reader-lease/run-01

mkdir -m 0755 "$companion/scripts"
for name in verify-live-reader-lease.py verify-handoff-ui.py verify-ui.py verify-fullscreen.py handoff_c4_business.py verify-cache-ui.py handoff_c5_ui.py handoff_c5_reader.py; do

  chmod 0444 "$companion/scripts/$name"
done
for name in src ui assets vendor examples Cargo.toml Cargo.lock build.rs; do
  test -e "$immutable/$name"
  ln -s "$immutable/$name" "$companion/$name"
done
if [ -e "$immutable/rust-toolchain.toml" ]; then
  ln -s "$immutable/rust-toolchain.toml" "$companion/rust-toolchain.toml"
fi
if [ -e "$immutable/.cargo/config.toml" ]; then
  mkdir -m 0755 "$companion/.cargo"
  ln -s "$immutable/.cargo/config.toml" "$companion/.cargo/config.toml"
  chmod 0555 "$companion/.cargo"
fi
chmod 0555 "$companion/scripts"
